prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1130; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene of a two-vehicle collision in Sugar Land, Texas, I observed a rear-end collision in the eastbound lanes of the roadway. Driver 1 was operating a sedan that was stopped in traffic when the front of the vehicle was struck in the rear by a pickup truck operated by Driver 2. Driver 2 stated that he was following too closely and did not stop in time. Both vehicles sustained visible damage to the front and rear bumpers, and both vehicles were able to be driven from the scene. A Passenger riding in Driver 1's vehicle was present and did not require transport. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness and was evaluated at the scene by emergency medical personnel. Driver 1 declined transport at that time. No citations were issued at the scene. Photographs were taken of both vehicles and the surrounding roadway, and statements were collected from all parties present.
